definitions.explanation: A large natural stream of water flowing to the sea.
A smaller body of flowing water.

examples.english: I caught fish in the river.

notes:
{川|かわ} means river or stream - a natural body of flowing water.

READINGS IN COMPOUNDS:
- かわ: standalone or beginning of compound ({川|かわ}⟦{魚|ざかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧)
- がわ: often at end of place names (⟦{隅田川|すみだがわ}→隅田川：noentry⟧)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {川|かわ}で⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim in a river
- {川|かわ}を⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross a river
- {川|かわ}が⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: a river flows
- {川|かわ}に⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the river

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧: riverbank
- ⟦{川上|かわかみ}→川上：25368_kawakami⟧: upstream
- ⟦{川下|かわしも}→川下：noentry⟧: downstream
- ⟦{小川|おがわ}→小川：06695_ogawa⟧: stream, brook
- ⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧: rivers (formal/official term)

FAMOUS JAPANESE RIVERS:
- ⟦{信濃川|しなのがわ}→信濃川：noentry⟧: Shinano River (longest in Japan)
- ⟦{利根川|とねがわ}→利根川：noentry⟧: Tone River
- ⟦{隅田川|すみだがわ}→隅田川：noentry⟧: Sumida River (Tokyo)
- ⟦{淀川|よどがわ}→淀川：noentry⟧: Yodo River (Osaka)
